# Media Creator
Turns a chat request into image-generation fields and renders the created image back into the chat.
## When to use
- A user asks in chat for a new image to be made.
## How it works
1. Calls the `creation_image_parse` structure on the thinking LLM and stores the result as the AI creation fields. 2. Renders `creation_image_render` with the asset and runs the children. 3. `createImage` sends the prompt to the `createimage` LLM, saves each result as a new asset under `Channels/<user>/<date>/`, and fires `importing/assetscreated`.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The chat message being answered
## Outputs
- `asset`, `refreshing`, and the rendered response
## Notes
- Work in progress: `process` renders a fixed test asset id instead of the image it creates.
## Implementation
- Bean `mediaCreatorSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.MediaCreationSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`
